name: roundstorm
description: Local-first multi-agent research deliberation: persistent AI researchers argue a hard question for N rounds.
author: Carlo Perassi

scripts.test: tsx --test server/src/*.test.ts server/src/headless/*.test.ts server/src/deliberation/*.test.ts server/src/adapters/*.test.ts server/src/sqlite/*.test.ts server/src/search/*.test.ts server/src/http/*.test.ts web/src/lib/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.app:build: npm run build && tauri build && npm run check:arch
scripts.coverage: tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage server/src/*.test.ts server/src/headless/*.test.ts server/src/deliberation/*.test.ts server/src/adapters/*.test.ts server/src/sqlite/*.test.ts server/src/search/*.test.ts server/src/http/*.test.ts web/src/lib/*.test.ts
